metadata.title: Secure Email

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating email as a secure, trustworthy, and institutionally governed communication system.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Institutional email systems including identity, threat protection, data governance, workflow relay, bulk messaging, and automation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that all required trust properties for secure institutional email are satisfied.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email assumes baseline email delivery, identity binding, and accountability.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires defensible sender identity and impersonation resistance.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires protection against phishing, malware, and social engineering.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires controls preventing misuse and leakage of sensitive data.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires defensible treatment of email as an institutional record.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires trusted handling of system-generated email.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires safe use of email as a workflow and collaboration relay.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires governed use of high-volume outbound email.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Initial access attempts commonly originate through email.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Credential access through phishing and identity deception.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Collection and exfiltration of sensitive information via email.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Phishing via email is a dominant attack vector.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid email accounts undermines trust and authority.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong authentication and identity assurance across email usage.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data access control to protect sensitive email content.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and traceability to support accountability and investigation.

metadata.remarks: Secure Email is a composite pattern asserting that all foundational, defensive, and governance requirements for institutional email have been satisfied. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for use in solution patterns, risk analysis, and system security and privacy plans.
